network_status.summary_it: Il dossier regionale conferma la ricostruzione del ponte crollato sul Rio Maggiore a Limoncino e raccoglie gli studi idraulici successivi, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata osservata alla sezione durante l'evento. Le portate di progetto non vengono confuse con misure del 2017.
network_status.summary_en: The regional dossier confirms reconstruction of the collapsed Rio Maggiore bridge at Limoncino and lists subsequent hydraulic studies, but publishes no observed stage or discharge at the section during the event. Design flows are not confused with 2017 measurements.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
